  "recovered_c": "#include <stdint.h>\n#include <stddef.h>\n\n#define VERA_ERR 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF\n\nuint64_t fn_18(const uint8_t *in, size_t len, uint64_t arg, uint8_t *out, size_t out_cap) {\n  size_t d = 0;\n  uint q = 0;\n  size_t i = 0;\n  size_t out_cap_local = out_cap;\n  uint8_t *out_local = out;\n  uint8_t *in_local = (uint8_t *)in;\n  uint8_t c;\n  uint8_t st[64];\n\n  if (len == 0) {\n    if (d == 0 && q == 0) {\n      return 0;\n    } else {\n      return len + 1;\n    }\n  }\n\n  while (1) {\n    if (len <= i) {\n      if (d == 0 && q == 0) {\n        return 0;\n      } else {\n        return len + 1;\n      }\n    }\n\n    c = in[i];\n\n    if (q == 2) {\n      q = 1;\n    } else if (q == 1) {\n      if (c == '\\') {\n        q = 2;\n      } else if (c == '\"') {\n        q = 0;\n      }\n    } else if (c == '\"') {\n      q = 1;\n    } else if ((c == '(') || (c == '[') || (c == '{')) {\n      if (d == 0x40) {\n        return i + 1;\n      }\n      if (c == '(') {\n        c = ')';\n      } else {\n        c = c + 0x2;\n      }\n      st[d] = c;\n      d = d + 1;\n    } else if ((c == ')') || (c == ']') || (c == '}')) {\n      if (d == 0 || c != st[d - 1]) {\n        return i + 1;\n      }\n      d = d - 1;\n    }\n\n    i = i + 1;\n  }\n\n  return 0;\n}\n"
}
